description: APIs.guru open directory of public API descriptions (OpenAPI specs): finds API providers by domain name (e.g. stripe, 1forge, googleapis) and returns each of their APIs with title, preferred version, description, categories, the OpenAPI spec URL and dates. Open-source catalogue of published specs, not a list of companies. Related tools on this server, for a different need: b2b_doabooks_directory_open_access when you need Peer-reviewed open access books from DOAB, the Directory; b2b_listennotes_podcasters_directory when you need Listen Notes podcast search: finds podcasts by keyword. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

q.description: Provider domain or part of it, 2 to 60 characters (e.g. stripe, twilio)
